links.comparator_used: Single fixed cut-off threshold optimized for the older software version (v3.1.0.0) reused on the newer version (v3.9.0.1)
links.outcome: Accuracy (sensitivity and specificity) of Lunit INSIGHT CXR for TB detection at clinically relevant cut-offs, against Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra
links.effect: With the old version's threshold, the newer software was significantly less accurate than its predecessor. After re-calibrating the cut-off, there were no significant differences in sensitivity and specificity between versions. No numeric values for the threshold comparison were given in the abstract.
links.quote: When using an cut-off threshold optimized for the older software version, the newer software was significantly less accurate than its predecessors.
